item.title: U.S. producer prices rose 0.5% in December, more than expected, on uptick in services inflation
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) – U.S. wholesale prices rose a hotter-than-expected 0.5% in December. The Labor Department reported Friday that its producer price index – which measures inflation before it hits consumers – rose from November to December at the fastest pace in three months and faster than the 0.3% economists had forecast. Compared to December 2024, producer prices were up 3% last […]

item.title: Report: Quonset Business Park generates $7B annually for R.I. economy
item.description: NORTH KINGSTOWN – Quonset Business Park generates $7 billion annually in economic activity for Rhode Island, including $2.2 billion in household income, according to a new economic impact report by Bryant University.
